name: adopt
description: Existing-project adoption. In a repository that already has code, traces one representative flow per capability candidate and reverse-derives Layer 0 and capability design zones. Use only with explicit devflow intent—direct invocation, naming devflow, or asking to adopt an existing codebase into devflow, reverse-derive Layer 0, or create or repair devflow capability documents.
problem: Preserve the behavior of the immutable repository source at skills/adopt without silently changing its obligations.
state_dependent_behaviors: Source contains candidate conditional, ordered, or evidence-bound behavior requiring review.
judgment_points: Every source atom remains review-required until explicitly disposed.
